uncited: It addresses the limitations of standard single-stage optimization, which fails with large initial pose errors [8223-cascaded-bundle-adjusting-neural-radiance-fields-cbarf.md] or suffers from memory bottlenecks and blending artifacts when scaling to arbitrarily large scenes [10947-nerf-xl-joint-training.md].

It sets itself apart from sibling methods like BlockNeRF or MegaNeRF by either using a cascaded coarse-to-fine pose refinement strategy [8223-cascaded-bundle-adjusting-neural-radiance-fields-cbarf.md] or by enforcing 0% overlap with joint training of global embeddings to eliminate train-test discrepancies [10947-nerf-xl-joint-training.md].
**Reverse-Mode Automatic Differentiation (AD):** Standard backpropagation through the computational graph.
**Adjoint Method:** Computes gradients by propagating adjoint variables backward through the rendering algorithm.
**Analytic Inversion / Explicit Gradients:** Uses a-priori knowledge of the DVR operations to derive closed-form gradients, reducing memory consumption.
